weeks.week_title: Week 1: From Corporal to Sergeant — Historical Review, Scope, and Source-Based Method

required_reading.title: Sergeant School — 8 Week Lesson Plan Program
Corporal School — 8 Week Lesson Plan Program

memory_targets: Sergeant study deepens the Corporal historical foundation through source-based method.
Truthful history requires evidence, chronology, and disciplined judgment.
Friday the 13th, Grail legends, and conspiracies must be taught carefully and critically.

weeks.week_title: Week 2: Expansion, Patronage, and Legitimacy in Europe

required_reading.title: Sergeant School — 8 Week Lesson Plan Program

memory_targets: Hugh de Payns’ European tour helped secure broad support for the order.
Omne Datum Optimum in 1139 strengthened Templar autonomy and legitimacy.
Growth in influence always requires humility, accountability, and stewardship.

weeks.week_title: Week 3: Organization, Offices, Provinces, and Internal Classes

required_reading.title: Sergeant School — 8 Week Lesson Plan Program

memory_targets: The order was governed through a structured hierarchy and provincial network.
Historical sergeants were essential to manpower, logistics, and disciplined support.
Rank exists for responsibility and service rather than social privilege.

weeks.week_title: Week 4: Military Operations, Logistics, Command, and Disciplined Service

required_reading.title: Sergeant School — 8 Week Lesson Plan Program

memory_targets: Military effectiveness depended on disciplined organization and logistics.
The Latin Rule helped shape obedience, sobriety, and service.
Spiritual warfare in KTKC is tied to prayer, witness, and disciplined Christian conduct.

weeks.week_title: Week 5: Finance, Stewardship, Administration, and Public Trust

required_reading.title: Sergeant School — 8 Week Lesson Plan Program

memory_targets: The Templars developed trusted systems for transport, storage, and credit.
Public trust was one of the order’s greatest strengths and greatest vulnerabilities.
Christian leadership requires integrity in all matters involving money and responsibility.

weeks.week_title: Week 6: Strategic Strain, Acre, and the Crisis of Purpose

required_reading.title: Sergeant School — 8 Week Lesson Plan Program

memory_targets: The fall of Acre in 1291 marked a decisive blow to the Crusader position in the East.
As conditions changed, the Templars’ original role became more difficult to justify publicly.
Mission drift and loss of clarity can weaken even disciplined institutions.

weeks.week_title: Week 7: Philip IV, Clement V, Accusations, Torture, and Suppression

required_reading.title: Sergeant School — 8 Week Lesson Plan Program
HISTORY: Friday the 13th and the Knights Templar
National Geographic: Friday the 13th and Templar Myth

memory_targets: Mass arrests in France occurred on Friday, October 13, 1307.
Clement V suppressed the order in 1312 under heavy pressure from Philip IV.
Confessions obtained under torture must be treated with moral caution and historical care.

weeks.week_title: Week 8: Jacques de Molay, Hospitallers, Legacy, Myth versus History, and Sergeant Readiness

required_reading.title: Sergeant School — 8 Week Lesson Plan Program
National Geographic: Friday the 13th and Templar Myth

memory_targets: Jacques de Molay is remembered as the final Grand Master of the order.
Much Templar property passed to the Hospitallers after suppression, though outcomes varied by ruler and region.
Friday the 13th mythology should not be taught as a proven historical origin story.
